title: WatchlistAddedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'watchlist.added'. Phosphor Wave 2 lane L3: emitted when a user adds an item to their watchlist (PUT /watchlist/{itemId}), in the SAME transaction as the watchlists row insert (packages/db/src/query/watchlist.ts's addToWatchlistAndEmit). USER-SCOPED delivery: the websocket broadcaster (apps/server/src/gateway/ws-broadcaster.service.ts) delivers this ONLY to sockets authenticated as `userId` below, never broadcast to other viewers (packages/db/src/query/events.ts's USER_ONLY_TYPES) — this is deliberately NOT item-visibility-gated the way item.added/item.updated are: it is private to the acting user regardless of who else can see the underlying item, which is what makes the watchlist sync across a single user's own devices/tabs (design/phosphor README.md's 'Shared client state: watchlist ... must sync across devices via the events socket') without ever telling a DIFFERENT user what the first user watchlisted.
